thread:
alex: Pager kicked off at 03:12 UTC — sudden flurry of Spot interruptions + ASG rebalance wiped most of the gpu-pool in eu-west-1.
priya: Oof. Any CA errors or just ASG churn?
alex: ASG logs show capacity-rebalance triggered. CA was OK but nodes never reached Ready: kubelet crashloops. Kubelet logs point to IMDS throttling when node bootstrap tried to call the metadata service a lot (driver install + kubelet creds + kube-proxy).
theo: We saw this pattern before — massive metadata calls during cloud-init cause 429s, kubelet fails to get tokens and stays NotReady. When ASG terminates old instances it becomes a cascade.
lara: Can we harden the node bootstrap so it doesn't hammer IMDS? Maybe query IMDSv2 once and cache token, add retries/backoff.
priya: Agreed. Also worth adding ASG instance_warmup + lifecycle hook so CA has time to schedule pods before instances are eligible for scale-down.
ops-bot: infra-bot: FYI new issue created: #infra/1569 "gpu pool IMDS throttling + ASG rebalance".
alex: Short-term mitigation I propose:
- terraform: set ASG capacity_rebalance = true, instance_warmup = 300
- terraform: in launch template, set metadata_options: http_tokens = "required", http_put_response_hop_limit = 2
- helm (cluster-autoscaler): add --scale-down-unneeded-time=25m --balance-similar-node-groups=true --ok-total-unready-count=6
- add a small on-demand buffered-gpu nodepool (min:1, desired:1) tagged for critical jobs

theo: Buffered on-demand pool is a good idea. Keeps critical pods alive during spot storms.
priya: For helm values, also set ca.extraArgs: ["--max-node-provision-time=12m"] — gives CA more time to consider new nodes healthy before scaling decisions.
lara: For bootstrap changes, I'll patch cloud-init to obtain IMDSv2 token once and store in /var/lib/node/bootstrap_imds_token, use exponential backoff for metadata calls and add jitter. Also throttle concurrent metadata callers via flock in the init script.
alex: Terraform snippet for launch template metadata:

```hcl
resource "aws_launch_template" "gpu_lt" {
  metadata_options {
    http_tokens = "required"
    http_put_response_hop_limit = 2
  }
}
```

priya: Also adding lifecycle hook in ASG to delay termination and send notification to SQS so we can drain gracefully.
theo: We need to be careful to not accidentally change the nodegroup type (managed vs ASG). Make these updates in the module inputs so it's non-destructive.

infra-bot: ci: terraform plan for branch/gpu-imds-fix passed (no replace actions flagged).

alex: Long-term ideas:
- move heavy subprocesses (driver install, model cache prefetch) into an immutable AMI bake so bootstrap is lightweight
- implement a Spot-allocator that prefers AZs with recent stability (we can push spot fallback to on-demand gracefully)
- instrument IMDS 429 alerts: treat >100 429s/min from nodes as high severity

priya: Agree on AMI bake. For now I'll open a PR with the helm CA flags + buffered nodepool TF module and a small cloud-init patch.
lara: I'll own the cloud-init patch and a unit test that simulates IMDS 429 and validates retry+token behavior.

alex: Post-merge checklist:
- run terraplan in staging
- spin up buffered-gpu pool in staging and simulate spot interruptions
- run small canary job that pins to buffered pool and a standard job that tolerates preemption
- monitor CA events, node readiness, and IMDS 429 rate

theo: Add Grafana alert: k8s.imds.429_rate > 50/min across nodes -> page oncall.
priya: Also add Slack alert to #eng-infra for ASG lifecycle-hook-failed metrics.

infra-bot: deploybot: helm chart cluster-autoscaler v1.22.0 updated with extra args in staging.

alex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1488 — includes TF buffered pool, LT metadata options, and CA helm values. CC @priya @lara @theo

priya: Reviewing now. Quick note: ensure buffered pool nodeSelector is gpu=true and tolerations match the job pods.
lara: Patch LGTM. Will add cloud-init smoke test.

alex: Merging after green CI. We'll run a 24h observation in staging before promoting. :thumbsup:
